    • showLocked

      @NotNull public @NotNull CosmeticTypeDefinition.Builder showLocked(boolean showLocked)
      Whether /cosmetics also lists, marked locked, the cosmetics a player can neither use nor buy. False when not set: those are hidden, as Zentrix hides gliders a player does not own.

    • previews

      @NotNull public @NotNull CosmeticTypeDefinition.Builder previews(boolean previews)
      Whether the handler implements CosmeticHandler.startPreview(org.bukkit.entity.Player, dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.cosmetics.CosmeticDefinition, dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.cosmetics.CosmeticPreview, java.lang.Runnable), so /cosmetics offers right-click to preview. False when not set. CosmeticsService.startPreview(org.bukkit.entity.Player, dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.cosmetics.CosmeticTypeKey, java.lang.String) asks the handler either way.
